fact: The June 2021 Project Appraisal Document for Digital Gabon plans a Biometric Registry of Physical Persons issuing a unique NIP whose uniqueness is established by automated fingerprint deduplication through an ABIS, and records that a 2011 biometric deduplication reform of the ID card ended in 2014.
title: Project Appraisal Document on a proposed loan to the Gabonese Republic for a Digital Gabon Project
